# What Axiom API tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is. That run is sixteen characters and a body is a UUID of
# thirty-two hexadecimal ones, so the run is carried round again and laid into
# the groups of a UUID as 01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef. Where a case is
# about the ends of the alphabet or about a character the body excludes, the
# character at that position is the only one that moves.

patterns: axiom-api-token

# The one prefix Axiom issues an API token with, in the places a token is
# written. There is a single kind of string here rather than a table of them,
# because the privileges an API token carries are not written into it: the value
# is the prefix and a UUID whatever the token was created to do.

case:     a token in an environment assignment
in:       AXIOM_TOKEN=xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      AXIOM_TOKEN=«axiom-api-token»

case:     a token in the bearer authorization header the Axiom API is called with
in:       Authorization: Bearer xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      Authorization: Bearer «axiom-api-token»

case:     a token in the json body that provisions an organization
in:       {"token":"xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"}
out:      {"token":"«axiom-api-token»"}

case:     a token passed to the client the SDK guides initialize
in:       axiom.SetToken("xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef")
out:      axiom.SetToken("«axiom-api-token»")

case:     a token in yaml
in:       axiom_token: xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      axiom_token: «axiom-api-token»

case:     a token in a diff line
in:       +AXIOM_TOKEN=xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      +AXIOM_TOKEN=«axiom-api-token»

case:     a token in a markdown code span
in:       `xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef`
out:      `«axiom-api-token»`

# The alphabet the groups are written in, which is hexadecimal in either case,
# and the characters just outside it at the ends of a body.

case:     a body written in capitals
in:       xaat-01234567-89AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF
out:      «axiom-api-token»

case:     a body opening on the last lowercase letter hexadecimal admits
in:       xaat-f1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      «axiom-api-token»

case:     a body closing on the last digit
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcde9
out:      «axiom-api-token»

case:     the letter above hexadecimal where a body opens
in:       xaat-g1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xaat-g1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     the letter above hexadecimal where a body closes
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdeg
out:      xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdeg

case:     an underscore in the body
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab_cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xaat-01234567-89ab_cdef-0123-456789abcdef

# The layout rather than a count. The four separators stand at fixed places and
# are the whole of what tells a UUID from thirty-six other characters written
# behind the prefix, so a body of the right length whose separators fall
# elsewhere is not a token.

case:     a body of thirty-six characters laid out as a uuid is a token
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      «axiom-api-token»

case:     a body one character short of the layout
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcde
out:      xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcde

case:     a separator missing from the body
in:       xaat-0123456789ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef0
out:      xaat-0123456789ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef0

case:     a separator where the body carries a hexadecimal digit
in:       xaat--1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xaat--1234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     a hexadecimal run longer than the layout is a token and what follows it
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef0
out:      «axiom-api-token»0

# The prefix itself: the case Axiom writes it in, and the hyphen it closes with.

case:     the prefix written in capitals
in:       XAAT-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      XAAT-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     an underscore where the prefix carries its hyphen
in:       xaat_01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xaat_01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     a run of the right shape opening with no prefix
in:       xxxx-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xxxx-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

# What a token may be written against. There is no boundary on either side of
# it, so a token keeps its span whatever word character it abuts — and the
# layout ends it at its forty-first character, so whatever is written after one
# stays in the text whether the body's alphabet admits it or not.

case:     a token after an underscore
in:       AXIOM_TOKEN_xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      AXIOM_TOKEN_«axiom-api-token»

case:     a token after a letter
in:       zxaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      z«axiom-api-token»

case:     a word written against a token
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdefsuffix
out:      «axiom-api-token»suffix

case:     a hyphenated word written against a token
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef-suffix
out:      «axiom-api-token»-suffix

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef.
out:      the token is «axiom-api-token».

case:     a token immediately against japanese on both sides
in:       トークンはxaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdefです
out:      トークンは«axiom-api-token»です

case:     a token against an invalid byte
in:       \xffxaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef\xff
out:      \xff«axiom-api-token»\xff

# Two tokens written together. No token can begin inside another — a body is
# hexadecimal and the separator alone, where the prefix carries two characters
# of neither — so the spans this pattern reports never overlap. The prefix
# written twice is the nesting that remains: the outer candidate's body opens on
# the x of the second prefix and so is no body, and the token stands five
# characters into the forty-one that candidate reached over. A scan stepping
# past a candidate it rejected would lose it.

case:     a token inside a candidate the body turned away
in:       xaat-xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      xaat-«axiom-api-token»

case:     two tokens with nothing between them
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdefxaat-01234567-89AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF
out:      «axiom-api-token»«axiom-api-token»

case:     two tokens separated by a space
in:       xaat-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef xaat-01234567-89AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF
out:      «axiom-api-token» «axiom-api-token»

# The other kind of token Axiom issues, which this pattern does not read: a
# personal access token, written xapt- and the same UUID behind it.
# AxiomPersonalAccessToken is what reads that one. Such a token performs every
# action its holder can perform where an API token carries only the privileges it
# was created with, so a caller redacting one has reason not to redact the other,
# and the two belong under separate switches rather than under this one widened
# to cover both.

case:     a personal access token
in:       AXIOM_TOKEN=xapt-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      AXIOM_TOKEN=xapt-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     a personal access token in the bearer authorization header
in:       Authorization: Bearer xapt-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      Authorization: Bearer xapt-01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

# A UUID with nothing in front of it, which is the shape an identifier is
# written in and one a pattern here may not be anchored on. The prefix is the
# whole of what tells a token from a request id or a row key, so what is left
# without it stays in the text — as do the separators of a timestamp, which fall
# at their own places rather than at a UUID's, and a digest, which carries no
# separator at all.

case:     a uuid on its own
in:       01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     a uuid as a request id
in:       request_id=01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef
out:      request_id=01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef

case:     an iso timestamp in a log line
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="query completed"
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="query completed"

case:     a git sha
in:       0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
